Can ordinary toilet paper become a heat shield?
We compress toilet paper into a solid brick using our hydraulic press, then put it to the test with an oxy-acetylene torch. What happens when something that normally burns so easily is packed this tightly?
Watch us make the brick, test its heat resistance, and see what’s left afterwards.
What should we compress and test next? Leave your ideas in the comments!
Do not try this at home. This experiment uses dangerous machinery and extreme heat. Compressed toilet paper is not a certified fire-protection material.
#HydraulicPressChannel #HydraulicPress #ToiletPaper
